text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our major goal to compete in the Tokyo

Daishoten is fast approaching.
Meanwhile, I put
Inari One down for the
autumn Tenno Sho to
build some
experience in big races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Here, she'll have two of the best racers
in her
generation to contend with!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This showdown is bound to fuel Inari
One's
passion!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, the Beast... and Tamamo
Cross, or
White Lightnin'.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sure is somethin' to be lined up
next to
them. Makes me want a
nickname of my own!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know that! Some folks are callin' this
the battle
for the top!
choice_data_list_en: This is going to be a tough fight.
This will be a tough fight.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And I'm gonna be smack dab in the
middle of it! I
can't wait to get a taste of
this festival!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I finally get to race against you, Oguri.
I've been
lookin' forward to this day for
a long time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Are you all right? Did you get enough
sleep
yesterday? Did you eat enough
food?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why da hell are ya worryin' over my
wellbein'?! Ya
sound like you're sendin'
your kid off to camp!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I slept like a log. And I ate all my meals.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been looking forward to
today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heh, good. Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Oguri. Today, I'm beatin' ya
down to a
pulp. I'll show everyone who's
the best in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So ya better be ready.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure. I'm more than ready... to win.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I didn't know ya had a cool
comeback up
your sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's racin' time... Let's get this started,
shall we?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wow, Tama and Oguri are all in!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Tamamo Cross may be a pip-squeak,
but she's
got a good pair of legs and one
heck of a fightin'
spirit. I know she's the
same ol' Tama standin'
next to the same
ol' Oguri, but...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Crap, they both look so threatenin'... But
that
makes this all the better!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This may be your festival, but I'm gonna
be the
grand finale!
